text:
When the inducing magnet is removed, fome mag-
netti remains in the fixed bar, which retains the polo-
ry which, it will be the neighborhood of the matter.

parsed.faithful: When the inducing magnet is removed, fome magnetism remains in the fixed bar, which retains the polarity which it had in the neighbourhood of the magnet.
parsed.modern: When the inducing magnet is removed, some magnetism remains in the fixed bar, which retains the polarity which it had in the neighbourhood of the magnet.
